sections.heading: Ivanka Trump — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ivanka Trump was born on 30 October 1981 in Manhattan, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Ivana Marie Trump at birth and is publicly known as Ivanka Trump.
Public records name her mother, Ivana Trump. She is a sibling of Tiffany Trump, Eric Trump, Donald Trump Jr. and Barron Trump.
Her listed education includes Choate Rosemary Hall, The Wharton School, Chapin School and Georgetown University.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Ivanka Trump — Career and Professional Work
paras: Ivanka Trump works primarily as a businessperson, model, non-fiction writer, politician, television presenter and fashion designer, with Federal Government of the United States, The Trump Organization and Forest City Realty Trust listed among her employers.
She has held the following offices: Senior Advisor to the President of the United States (2017–2021). She is affiliated with Republican Party.
She has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2020, Global Conference 2019 and Lex Fridman Podcast.
